off.question: Ujjwala yojana ke liye kaun eligible hai?
off.answer: Ujjwala Yojana ke liye eligible hona ke liye aapko ek poor household ki adult woman hona chahiye aur aapke ghar mein pehle se LPG connection nahi hona chahiye [2].
